question_words.use: Put it where the answer goes: 你叫什么？ — 我叫小美。 Before a noun it means "what kind of": 什么书？
question_words.q: How do you say what in Chinese?

question_words.use: Also said shuí. Takes the place of the person: 他是谁？ 谁是老师？
question_words.q: How do you say who in Chinese?

question_words.use: Needs a measure word or noun after it: 哪个？ 哪本书？ 你是哪国人？
question_words.q: How do you say which in Chinese?

question_words.use: Northern speech says 哪儿, southern and Taiwan speech says 哪里 (nǎlǐ). Usually after 在 or 去: 你去哪儿？
question_words.q: How do you say where in Chinese?

question_words.use: Same as 哪儿. Also a modest reply to praise: 哪里哪里 "not at all".
question_words.q: What is the difference between 哪儿 and 哪里?

question_words.use: When you expect an answer under about ten, and always with a measure word: 你家有几口人？ Also for dates and clock time: 几点？ 几月几号？
question_words.q: How do you ask how many in Chinese?

question_words.use: For any number, often without a measure word: 多少钱？ 你们学校有多少学生？
question_words.q: What is the difference between 几 and 多少?

question_words.use: Before a verb it asks how to do it: 这个字怎么读？ With a surprised tone it means "how come": 你怎么没来？
question_words.q: How do you say how in Chinese?

question_words.en: how is it; what do you think
question_words.use: At the end, asking for an opinion or a suggestion: 这个菜怎么样？ 我们明天去，怎么样？
question_words.q: How do you ask how is it in Chinese?

question_words.use: Goes before the verb or at the start: 你为什么学汉语？ The answer usually starts with 因为.
question_words.q: How do you say why in Chinese?

question_words.use: Time goes before the verb in Chinese, so the question word does too: 你什么时候回家？
question_words.q: How do you say when in Chinese?

question_words.use: Before an adjective: 多大？ how old / how big; 多长时间？ how long; 多远？ how far.
question_words.q: How do you ask how old or how long in Chinese?

question_words.use: Add it to the end of a statement to make a yes/no question: 你是学生。 → 你是学生吗？
question_words.q: How do you make a yes or no question in Chinese?

question_words.use: After a noun it asks the same question back: 我很好，你呢？ It also softens a question word question.
question_words.q: What does 呢 mean in a question?

question_words.use: Checks something you think is true: 你是老师吧？ Or makes a suggestion: 我们走吧。
question_words.q: What is the difference between 吗 and 吧?

building: 百 = hundred; say the 一
a gap in the middle is read as 零
after 百, ten is 一十, not 十
两 before 千 and 万 is more common than 二
万 = ten thousand; Chinese groups big numbers by four digits
numbers.er_liang: Use 二 èr for counting, in phone numbers, in dates and inside bigger numbers (十二, 二十). Use 两 liǎng in front of a measure word: 两个人, 两本书, 两点 (two o'clock). Before 百 either is heard; before 千 and 万, 两 is more usual.
dates: Years are read digit by digit
Months are just number + 月: 一月 is January, 十二月 is December
号 in speech, 日 rì in writing
èr líng èr liù nián jiǔ yuè sānshí rì
Big to small: year, month, day
星期 + 1 to 6 is Monday to Saturday
Also 星期日; 周一…周日 is common in writing
time: 一刻 = a quarter; 三刻 = 45 minutes
差 = short of, five to four
The part of the day comes first: 早上 上午 中午 下午 晚上
money: On price tags and in formal speech
The last unit is often dropped
numbers.order: Time words go before the verb, and the order is big to small: 我明天上午九点去学校。 (I go to school at nine tomorrow morning: literally I tomorrow morning nine o'clock go school.)
